Deutsche Bank – FTE Experience  
2023-2024 Placements Adarsh 
Sandukwar (201090062) 
Final Year Electronics and Telecommunication 
________________________________________________________
________________________________________________________ 
  
 
About Deutsche Bank 
 
Deutsche Bank visited our campus in first week of August to hire final year students 
for the role of Graduate Technical Analyst in Technology Data and Innovation (TDI) 
Business Division.   
 
Role: Graduate Analyst  
Business Division: Technology Data & Innovation 
Location: Pune 
Package- CTC 19.63 lpa  
Applicable Courses:  
B.Tech - Computer Engineering ,B.Tech - Information Technology ,B.Tech - Electronics 
& Telecommunication Engineering

CPI: 7 and above  
 
Online Coding Round (1.5 hrs): 
It was an online test on HackerEarth platform. There were 3 coding questions in 
this round. The questions were of easy-medium difficulty. The scores for questions 
were 20,50,50 respectively. There were marks for partial test cases.  
 
Questions: 
 
1. Power Limit (Score-20) A and B are 2 resources. At each round, we have to 
select 1 resource. The power of the resource at the time of selection should be 
greater than 1. Every second, the power of the selected resource gets reduced by 
2 and the power of the unselected resource gets charged by 1. The software stops 
when at least one resource has NO power. We have to print the maximum number 
of seconds software can run if you select the resources optimally.  
Sample input: 3 5  
Sample output: 6 
 
 
 
 
2. You are given a query string and an array of strings. Your task is to find the 
closest string to the given query string using the Levenshtein distance. The 
Levenshtein distance between two strings is defined as the minimum number of 
single-character edits (insertion, deletion, or substitution) required to change one 
string into the other.Write a function that takes a query string and an array of strings 
as inputs and returns the string from the array that has the smallest Levenshtein 
distance to the query string. Query string "apple"; String[] strings =["apples", 
"banana", "apricot", "grape", "peach"] 
Output: “apples” 
 
3.I can't recall the third question, but I know it had something to do with map.

Technical Interview 1: 
 
1. Introduce Yourself. 
2. What is inheritance? Give an example. 
3. Further they asked me to create different classes using inheritance to 
create a Hospital like system. 
4. Then the interviewer asked me to create a database for the hospital. 
5. Then on the created database they asked me some easy to moderate 
level SQL queries.  
6. Different types of data structures you know about. 
7. What is Tree and write the code for inorder,preorder and postorder 
traversal and also dry run all of them. 
8. Next question was to check if a number is prime. 
9. To find a missing number from 1 to n. 
10. Real life example of stack. 
11. Explain recursion using Fibonacci series. 
 
 
12. The last question was: 
        Problem Statement: 
Suppose a man had some amount in his wallet, he knows a bank 
that doubles the money immediately but the fee at the entrance of 
the bank is Rs 1000 and Rs 1000 as the exit fee. The man visited 3 
branches of the same bank and when he left the last bank he had Rs 
0 in his wallet. Find out what was the initial amount? 
 
The first technical round lasts for 40-50 min approx.

Technical Interview 2: 
 
 I actually don't remember much about the 2nd round , I will try to address          
some of those questions. 
 
1.Introduce Yourself. 
2.Asked about my projects. 
3.Different types of sorting algorithm , then asked me to write a code for quick 
sort . 
4.A question where we have to arrange the numbers according to the 
number of times they appear in an array. 
Example : 
Input 1223231155559862 
Output:6893311122225555 
5.And many more questions were on my projects , some questions on queue. 
6.ACID properties along with examples , the interviewer was not expecting 
a bookish language but instead wanted me to explain each property with 
examples , so I explained each property using examples. 
7. What is Indexing, how it's helpful. 
8.What is  normalization? What is the need of it? 
9.The interviewer asked me if i am planning to go for higher studies as i 
mentioned my gate rank. 
There were many more questions but actually i am not able to recall. 
 
This round lasted for something near to an hour. 
 
Professional Fitness Round : 
1.The interviewer asked me if I had lunch. 
2.Introduce yourself. 
3.Asked to explain my projects. 
4. As one of my projects was based on crypto currency, the interviewer 
asked me about crypto currency and the stock market. 
5.Whether i have any investment in the stock market. 
6 What knowledge do you have about finance, asked how UPI works.

7.There were some questions based on DBMS along with some sql queries 
like inner join, full join ,etc. 
8.Different types of sql languages or commands .  
9.What work did you do in your internship?   
10.Challenges faced during corona, as classes were online. 
11.Then it was time for some behavioral questions. I don't exactly 
remember the question but most of them were related to the bond between 
employee and manager. 
12.Difference between ego and self-respect. 
13.Again the last question was a puzzle: 
There are 1000 wine bottles. One of the bottles contains poisoned wine. A 
rat dies after one hour of drinking the poisoned wine. How many minimum 
rats are needed to figure out which bottle contains poison in an hour. 
 
This round lasted nearly 40 minutes. 
 
 
 
 
 
HR round: 
 
It was the most chill round I was the first one to go to the HR round. 
1.Introduce yourself. 
2.Explain projects. 
3.Your native place. 
4.Family background. 
5.Fathers occupation. 
6.As my gate rank was a bit good, they asked why I didn't want to do mtech 
from IIT and get a better package. 
7. Why do you want to join DB , for money or your interest towards finance 
and technology. 
8.Extracurricular activities.

9.As i mentioned cricket, asked me  about my favorite cricket player and 
team. 
 
And many such questions were asked,it was rather a friendly conversation 
than an interview. 
It lasted for nearly an hour. 
 
I was the one who had to give two HR rounds. I completed my first HR round 
at 6:30 pm and they called me for another round at 8 pm. 
 
However this round lasted for 10 minutes: 
 
1.Introduce yourself. 
2.Explain Projects. 
3.why should we hire you. 
4. Three strengths and weaknesses. 
5. Why do you want to join DB? 
 
So be ready for an extra round. 
 
At around 8:30 PM results were declared and I was among those 26 selected 
students. 
  
 
 
TIPS: 
1. Try to maintain a good pointer above 8 will be a plus point, but try to 
keep above 7.5 
2. Try to practice as many DSA questions don't just rely upon theory. 
3. Also cover DBMS,OOPS,CN,OS . 
4. Along with your DSA skills , projects matter a lot so focus on your 
projects too . 
5. Improve your communication skills. 
6. Try to keep your resume simple but effective , don't put any false 
information .

7. Most importantly enjoy your preparation.
